name: Fix the Bug (Hard)
description: The frontier variant of Fix the Bug, on the same tools and sandbox. Larger repositories (10–14 files: an inventory service with an async store, a Markdown converter, a meeting-room booking calendar), each with three interacting bugs whose symptoms point away from their cause: a race condition that only shows under concurrent orders, a shared default object that leaks options between orders, a module-level counter that makes output depend on what ran before, an operator-precedence slip that surfaces as a confusing validation error. The bug report describes symptoms, not causes. 40 actions and 250,000 output tokens; hidden tests check the same behaviour thoroughly, including concurrency invariants.
hook: Three bugs that hide behind each other, a bug report that points the wrong way, and hidden tests that check the concurrency too.
author: Gauntlet Core
